(Story: CRM-104)

- **CRM-107 completed** --- Repository & Developer Workflow:

## Story Goal

Establish the **Angular frontend workspace** under
`src/frontend/` that hosts two distinct application surfaces ---
**Agent CRM** and **Customer Portal** --- plus a small
set of **reusable shared libraries** with strict dependency
boundaries. Configure routing, environment configuration, HTTP client,
API base URL wiring, global styles, linting, formatting, PrimeNG +
PrimeIcons baseline, and an Arabic/English RTL/LTR direction foundation.
Both applications must build for production and lint cleanly.

**In scope:** workspace scaffolding, shared library boundaries,
PrimeNG integration proof, environment/runtime config plumbing,
i18n/direction foundation (mechanism only), lint/format, build
verification.

**Not in scope:** business feature screens, full application
shell UX (CRM-117), full translation content (CRM-116), auth/session
(CRM-110), API clients for capabilities that don't exist yet, complete
custom design system, Angular Material, backend/API code, CI quality
gates (CRM-203), full test/architecture-test suite (CRM-202).

## Product rules (from story)

- **Current behaviour:** `src/frontend/` is an empty
placeholder (`.gitkeep` + stub README). No Angular workspace exists.

- **New behaviour:** `src/frontend/` contains an Angular
workspace with **two applications** and **three shared
libraries** whose boundaries are enforced by tooling (path
mappings + lint rule / boundary check). Production build succeeds for
both apps. PrimeNG renders in both. Direction toggles from `en` → LTR
and `ar` → RTL via a shared mechanism.

## Implementation tasks

> Package manager: use **npm** (default for `ng new`) unless
a repo-wide preference is documented. Angular version: latest stable at
implementation time (project uses standalone components; do not add
NgModule scaffolding unless required by a dependency).

### 1 --- Create the Angular workspace under `src/frontend/`

**Create files under:** `src/frontend/`

1. From the repo root run (inside `src/frontend/` after removing the
`.gitkeep`):

```bash

cd src/frontend

rm .gitkeep

npx --yes @angular/cli@latest new squad-crm-frontend \

   \--create-application=false \\

   \--package-manager=npm \\

   \--strict \\

   \--skip-git \\

   \--directory=.

```

Result: `src/frontend/angular.json`, `package.json`,
`tsconfig.json`, `tsconfig.app.json`, `tsconfig.spec.json`,
`.editorconfig` (merge --- do not overwrite root `.editorconfig`
rules).

2. **Preserve** the pre-existing `src/frontend/README.md`
intent --- replace its body with real workspace documentation (see task
8) but keep the file.

3. **Do not** commit `node_modules/`, `dist/`,
`.angular/` --- already covered by root `.gitignore` (lines 18--20).

### 2 --- Generate the two applications

Run inside `src/frontend/`:

```bash

npx ng generate application agent-crm \

\--routing=true --style=scss --standalone=true --ssr=false --skip-tests=false

npx ng generate application customer-portal \

\--routing=true --style=scss --standalone=true --ssr=false --skip-tests=false

```

Expected layout:

```

src/frontend/

├── angular.json

├── package.json

├── projects/

│ ├── agent-crm/

│ │ └── src/{app,environments,index.html,main.ts,styles.scss}

│ └── customer-portal/

│ └── src/{app,environments,index.html,main.ts,styles.scss}

```

For each application:

- Set `<html lang="en" dir="ltr">` in
`projects/<app>/src/index.html`. Direction is finalised at runtime
by the shared bootstrap (task 6); keeping a static default avoids a
flash of wrong direction.

- In `projects/<app>/src/main.ts`, keep the standalone
`bootstrapApplication(AppComponent, appConfig)` pattern.

- In `projects/<app>/src/app/app.config.ts` register:

- `provideRouter(routes)` --- routes owned per application
(`app.routes.ts`).

- `provideHttpClient(withInterceptorsFromDi())` --- shared
interceptors are contributed via the platform library (task 4).

- `provideAnimationsAsync()` --- required by PrimeNG.

- `provideAppConfig()` --- factory from the platform library that
exposes API base URL and locale settings (task 4).

### 3 --- Generate the shared libraries

Run inside `src/frontend/`:

```bash

npx ng generate library @squad-crm/platform --prefix=sc

npx ng generate library @squad-crm/shared-ui --prefix=sc

```

Expected `projects/` layout after generation:

```

projects/

├── agent-crm/

├── customer-portal/

├── platform/ # @squad-crm/platform --- bootstrap/runtime config, HTTP,
locale direction

└── shared-ui/ # @squad-crm/shared-ui --- genuinely reusable UI +
shared PrimeNG presentation setup

```

**Boundary rules (enforced in task 7):**

| Library | May depend on | May **NOT** depend on |

|---|---|---|

| `@squad-crm/util` | Angular core, RxJS only | `platform`,
`shared-ui`, any application |

| `@squad-crm/platform` | Angular, RxJS, `@squad-crm/util` |
`shared-ui`, any application |

| `@squad-crm/shared-ui` | Angular, PrimeNG, `@squad-crm/util`,
`@squad-crm/platform` | any application |

| `agent-crm` app | all three shared libs | `customer-portal`
internals |

| `customer-portal` app | all three shared libs | `agent-crm`
internals |

Configure `tsconfig.json` `paths`:

```json

{

"compilerOptions": {

"paths": {

  "@squad-crm/platform": ["projects/platform/src/public-api.ts"],

  "@squad-crm/shared-ui": ["projects/shared-ui/src/public-api.ts"]

}

}

}

```

**### 4 --- Runtime configuration & HTTP foundation in
@squad-crm/platform

The configuration must be runtime configuration, not a build-time
rewrite of Angular environment.production.ts. The same production
frontend artifact should be deployable to Dev/Test/UAT/Prod by changing
external configuration only.

Create files under: src/frontend/projects/platform/src/lib/config/

app-config.ts --- validated application configuration contract:

export interface AppConfig {
  apiBaseUrl: string;
  defaultLocale: 'en' | 'ar';
  supportedLocales: ReadonlyArray<'en' | 'ar'>;
  appSurface: 'agent-crm' | 'customer-portal';
}

Implement a bootstrap/runtime-config loader using the current
recommended Angular bootstrap mechanism for the installed Angular
version. Do not hard-code APP_INITIALIZER if it is deprecated for
that version.

Each application loads a public runtime file such as
/assets/config.json (or an equivalent static runtime config file
selected by the executor) before normal application behavior
starts.

Each application owns its own runtime config file because Agent CRM
and Customer Portal can be deployed independently. The
mechanism/contract is shared.

Example development config for Agent CRM:

{
  "apiBaseUrl": "http://localhost:5080",
  "defaultLocale": "en",
  "supportedLocales": ["en", "ar"],
  "appSurface": "agent-crm"
}

Customer Portal uses the same shape with
appSurface: "customer-portal".

Validation:

Reject startup when apiBaseUrl is missing, empty or a known
sentinel such as REPLACE_ME.

Validate locale values against the supported en / ar foundation.

Never place secrets in frontend runtime configuration; it is
publicly readable by design.

Mapping to repository environment contract:

env/frontend.env.example remains the deployment/operator contract for:

AGENT_CRM_API_BASE_URL

CUSTOMER_PORTAL_API_BASE_URL

DEFAULT_LOCALE

SUPPORTED_LOCALES

Later deployment/container automation may generate each application's
runtime config from those environment variables. CRM-104 establishes and
documents the runtime file contract; it does not implement
CRM-197/CRM-203 deployment automation.

HTTP foundation --- create under:
src/frontend/projects/platform/src/lib/http/

api-base-url.interceptor.ts --- reads the validated runtime
APP_CONFIG.apiBaseUrl and prefixes relative API request URLs.
Absolute http:// / https:// URLs pass through unchanged.

provide-http-platform.ts --- the only canonical frontend HTTP
bootstrap provider. It calls
provideHttpClient(withInterceptors([apiBaseUrlInterceptor])) (or
the equivalent current Angular API).

Applications call provideHttpPlatform(); they do not separately
call another provideHttpClient(...).

Do not add authentication headers, token refresh, retries or
business API clients here --- CRM-110 and later capability stories own
those behaviors.

5 --- PrimeNG + PrimeIcons baseline

Install compatible versions for the Angular version actually
scaffolded:

npm install primeng primeicons @primeng/themes

Verify PrimeNG's compatibility/current setup documentation for the
installed Angular/PrimeNG versions rather than assuming an older
API.

Configure PrimeNG once per application using the current PrimeNG
provider API. Use a minimal supported preset only to prove
integration. Do not establish a dark-mode policy, custom brand
palette or full design system in CRM-104; those belong to later
design/branding work.

Keep reusable PrimeNG presentation setup/tokens in
@squad-crm/shared-ui only when there is actual shared
configuration. Avoid premature wrapper components.

Load PrimeIcons and the minimal global/shared styling required by
the installed PrimeNG version using its current recommended setup.
Do not assume an SCSS @use form is valid for package CSS without
verifying the build.

Integration proof: each application's root AppComponent
renders one minimal PrimeNG button with a PrimeIcon. This is a
temporary smoke marker only, not application-shell UX; CRM-117
replaces it.

Do not import Angular Material or another broad competing UI
library.

6 --- Arabic/English + RTL/LTR direction foundation

Create under: src/frontend/projects/platform/src/lib/i18n/

locale.service.ts:

signals-based state for locale and derived direction;

ar → rtl, en → ltr;

updates <html lang> and <html dir>;

persists the selected locale under a stable key such as
sc.locale;

rejects unsupported persisted/input locale values and falls back
to the validated runtime default.

Bootstrap locale initialization using the current recommended
Angular mechanism for the installed version so the
persisted/default locale is applied as early as practical before
normal rendering. Do not mandate deprecated APP_INITIALIZER APIs.

Each application registers the shared locale foundation through a
platform provider.

Do not ship translation dictionaries, full translation
tooling/content or feature translations in CRM-104. CRM-116 owns that
work.

Do not create a permanent __dev/direction route solely for this
story. Verify the mechanism through unit tests and application
bootstrap/smoke tests. If the executor needs a temporary manual test
harness locally, it must not be committed.

## Edge Cases & Failure Modes

- **Environment variables missing at build time** ---
`environment.production.ts` values are the source of truth; CI
substitution failing should produce a build with clearly-wrong
placeholder URLs. Enforce a runtime guard in `provideAppConfig`: if
`apiBaseUrl` is empty or equals a known sentinel like `REPLACE_ME`,
throw at bootstrap. Enforced in
`projects/platform/src/lib/config/provide-app-config.ts`.

- **Absolute API URLs in requests** --- the
`apiBaseUrlInterceptor` must skip URLs that already start with
`http://` or `https://`. Covered by unit test in task Test Plan #3.

- **Direction flash on first paint** --- static `dir="ltr"`
on `<html>` matches the `en` default. If persisted locale is
`ar`, `LocaleService` must update `<html dir>` before the first
change-detection cycle (use `APP_INITIALIZER`, not a component
`ngOnInit`).

- **Unsupported persisted locale in `localStorage`** ---
reject any value not in `APP_CONFIG.supportedLocales`; fall back to
`defaultLocale`. Enforced in `provideLocale()`.

- **Cross-application import attempts** --- ESLint
`no-restricted-imports` rejects `projects/agent-crm/*` from
`customer-portal` and vice versa (task 7.3).

- **Angular Material or competing UI library sneaks in** ---
ESLint pattern rule rejects `@angular/material*`. Add a matching
entry for `@mui/*`, `bootstrap`, `@ionic/angular` to prevent
equivalents.

- **PrimeNG theme conflict with library import order** ---
`styles.scss` must import `primeicons` and shared-ui tokens in the
order shown in task 5.4; otherwise CSS specificity of overrides is
undefined.

- **Standalone bootstrap missing `provideAnimationsAsync`**
--- PrimeNG will silently render without animations and some overlays
(Dialog, OverlayPanel) break. Both apps must include the provider (task
2).

- **Duplicate `.gitignore` entries** --- Angular ignores are
already present at `.gitignore` lines 18--25; do not re-add.

- **`.editorconfig` conflicts** --- root `.editorconfig`
(270 B) already exists; if `ng new` writes its own, **merge**,
do not overwrite the root file.

## Test Plan

1. **Unit --- `LocaleService`
(`projects/platform/src/lib/i18n/locale.service.spec.ts`)**:
setting locale to `ar` sets `direction()` to `rtl` and applies
`dir="rtl"` on `document.documentElement`; setting to `en`
restores `ltr`. Rejects unsupported locale.

2. **Unit --- `provideLocale` initializer
(`projects/platform/src/lib/i18n/provide-locale.spec.ts`)**: reads
persisted `sc.locale`; falls back to `APP_CONFIG.defaultLocale` when
absent or invalid.

3. **Unit --- `apiBaseUrlInterceptor`
(`projects/platform/src/lib/http/api-base-url.interceptor.spec.ts`)**:
relative URL `/agents` gets prefixed with `apiBaseUrl`; absolute URL
passes through unchanged.

4. **Unit --- `provideAppConfig` guard**: throws when
`apiBaseUrl` is empty or equals `REPLACE_ME`.

5. **Smoke --- Agent CRM `AppComponent`
(`projects/agent-crm/src/app/app.component.spec.ts`)**: renders a
`p-button` (asserts PrimeNG element in DOM), and `<html lang>`
reflects default locale.

6. **Smoke --- Customer Portal `AppComponent`** --- mirror of
#5, asserts `appSurface === 'customer-portal'` in injected
`APP_CONFIG`.

7. **Boundary test --- ESLint**: add a purposely-broken
spec-only fixture in a dev-only branch during local verification (do not
commit) to confirm the `no-restricted-imports` rule fires for
`@angular/material` and cross-application imports. Documented but not
committed.

8. **Match precedent:** use Angular's Karma + Jasmine default
(`ng test --watch=false --browsers=ChromeHeadless`). CRM-202 will
replace this with the full test/architecture-test strategy.

## Migration / Rollback

- **State before:** `src/frontend/` contains only
`.gitkeep` + stub README. Nothing else in the repo depends on frontend
artefacts.

- **State after:** full Angular workspace present.
`src/frontend/README.md` rewritten. Root `README.md` gets a new
subsection. `.gitignore` unchanged.

- **Rollback (if the story fails verification):** delete
everything under `src/frontend/` except `.gitkeep` and restore the
original one-line `README.md`; revert the paragraph added to root
`README.md` and `docs/architecture/frontend.md`. No database, no
migrations, no external systems affected.

- **Half-applied risk:** the most likely half-applied state is
*"one application builds, the other does not"*. The Done Criteria
and Verification Steps both require **both** applications to
build cleanly before merging --- do not merge otherwise.

## Verification Steps

1. **Frontend installs:** `cd src/frontend && npm ci` ---
completes without errors; no peer-dep warnings escalated to errors.

2. **Frontend lints:** `cd src/frontend && npm run lint` ---
passes with zero errors (warnings allowed only for `TODO(CRM-116)` /
`TODO(CRM-117)` markers, if any).

3. **Frontend format check:** `cd src/frontend && npm run
format` --- passes.

4. **Agent CRM dev server:** `cd src/frontend && npm run
start` --- serves on default port; opening `/` shows the
PrimeNG smoke `p-button`; `<html lang="en" dir="ltr">`.

5. **Customer Portal dev server:** `cd src/frontend && npm run
start` --- serves on a distinct port (configure via
`angular.json` `serve.options.port`); shows PrimeNG smoke button.

6. **Direction toggle:** open `/__dev/direction` in each
app, click *"ar"* → `<html dir>` becomes `rtl` and reverts on
*"en"*. This proves the CRM-116 foundation without shipping CRM-116
content.

7. **Production build --- Agent CRM:** `cd src/frontend && npm
run build` --- succeeds; `dist/agent-crm/` produced.

8. **Production build --- Customer Portal:** `cd src/frontend
&& npm run build` --- succeeds;
`dist/customer-portal/` produced.

9. **Combined build:** `cd src/frontend && npm run build`
--- both succeed in sequence.

10. **No forbidden libraries:** `grep -R "@angular/material"
src/frontend/projects || true` returns nothing; likewise for
`@mui/`, `bootstrap`, `@ionic/angular`.

11. **Boundary check:** `grep -R "projects/agent-crm"
src/frontend/projects/customer-portal || true` returns nothing; and
reverse. `grep -R "@squad-crm/platform\|@squad-crm/shared-ui"
src/frontend/projects/util || true` returns nothing.

12. **Regression:** `.squad/`, `.claude/`, `docs/adr/`,
`docs/development/`, `CLAUDE.md`, `env/frontend.env.example`,
`.gitignore` (lines 1--5 squad-kit block, lines 17--25 Angular block)
are byte-identical to CRM-107 output except where this story explicitly
adds pointer paragraphs (§8, §9).
